newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sees new projects profits end-1998.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sees new projects profits end-1998.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Monday it did not see the bulk of profits from its new projects arriving until late calendar 1998.
"Definitely," BHP managing director John Prescott told a media briefing, when asked if the bulk of profit from these new projects would not arrive until late 1998.
"You're not going to see it in early 1998," he said.
BHP earlier said it saw a flat performance until profits from its new projects were commissioned.

Announcing it had completed a review of its future strategies, BHP said earlier that fourth quarter trading conditions remained difficult and it expected a flat performance until it restructured and new projects were commissioned.
BHP said there would be a number of abnormal adjustments to the full year to May 31 results, due on June 28, and that some of them would have an adverse impact.
BHP shares were 43 cents lower at A$18.89 at 3.20 p.m. (0520 GMT).
